courses: Video Art
Moving-image vocabulary

Two thirty-second edits with sequence maps.

Sound-image relation

Exhibition-ready screening
Review captions, projector aspect, playback loops, consent and credits.

Sound Art

Time-marked listening score and sound vocabulary.
Field-recording ethics
Demonstrate gain staging, clipping checks and consent for recognizable voices.

Original WAV/recording files and consent/location notes.
Sonic texture layers

Track arrangement screenshot and level log.
Spatial storytelling

Before/after mix and rhythm reflection.

Review safe listening volumes, text descriptions and transcript alternatives.

Final audio, text score, credits and hearing-safety note.
AI-Assisted Art Ethics

Develop a transparent AI-assisted concept study with original files and a rights checklist.

Design grid, midpoint photo and completed piece.
Finishing and display

Front/back photographs, material list and process reflection.

Four-stitch sampler with thread counts.
Line as drawing

Design transfer and stitched line study.

Stitch map and petal samples.

Silhouette sketching

Collection presentation
